Log every set with the metrics calisthenics needs:
• Reps or hold-time (seconds) per set
• Form score (1–10) — how clean was the rep
• RPE — how hard did it feel
• Added weight or resistance band
• Grip type (overhand, underhand, false grip, neutral)

—— INTELLIGENT PROGRESSION ——

• Volume tracking by week and month

results.description:
Get personalized coaching, improvement tips and rank up your calisthenics journey by analyzing your workout set.

Rate My Form turns your iPhone into a live form coach by providing joint tension updates & full ROM rep detection in real time. When your set is done, you get clear tips to fix weak spots and maximize your gains.


HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your exercise.
2. Place your phone on a stable surface.
3. Tap Start Analysis to begin analyzing your workout set.
4. Complete your set with live rep and joint feedback.
5. Tap Done and review your key workout insights, coaching & improvement tips, performance metrics etc.


CHALLENGES
Create or join challenges with friends, sync your sets and stay accountable together. Sign in is required for Challenges. Form analysis works without an account.


RANKED SYSTEM 
Earn XP from quality sets and climb the calisthenics ranks.
Unranked Calisthenics Athlete — 0 XP
E-Rank Calisthenics Athlete — 1,000 XP
D-Rank Calisthenics Athlete — 2,500 XP
C-Rank Calisthenics Athlete — 4,500 XP
B-Rank Calisthenics Athlete — 7,000 XP
A-Rank Calisthenics Athlete — 10,000 XP
S-Rank Calisthenics Athlete — 14,000 XP
National Level Calisthenics Athlete — 20,000 XP

XP is based on form quality, not just completing a set (up to 10 XP per set):
Proper full ROM → +5 XP
Good TUT → +5 XP
About 10 quality sets ≈ 100 XP. 
Reach S/National, then maintain your rank.


LOG WORKOUTS 
Build a full workout log from the Form Check screen. Name your session, track start time and duration and log each set with reps. Tap the camera on any set to run live form analysis, then return to your workout with that set’s results saved. 
Review insights per set as you train - all in one flow.


Built for people who care about clean reps and smarter progressive training - at home or in the gym.
No guesswork. No vague “good job.” Just measurable and actionable feedback on form quality.

Download Rate My Form to get personalized coaching & improvement tips and turn every set into measurable progress.


MEMBERSHIP
Core analysis is free. You can analyze your workouts and see the key issues holding your form back without a paywall. The free version includes limited coaching and improvement tips.
Want more guidance? You can unlock additional personalized coaching and improvement tips by watching a short rewarded ad (temporary unlock) or with a paid membership for full ongoing access.


USER PRIVACY
Form analysis runs on your device. The camera is used only for a live preview and on-device form feedback. Workout video is not uploaded to our servers and is not used for advertising.

If you create an account or use Challenges, we store account and challenge data so those features can work.
If you purchase a membership, purchase/subscription status is handled via Apple and RevenueCat.

We show optional rewarded ads so free users can temporarily unlock extra coaching insights. Ads start only after required privacy consent where applicable. Workout video is not sent to ad partners.

We also use the Meta SDK to measure and improve our own ads for Rate My Form on Instagram and Facebook. That may involve device and app event data and is subject to your App Tracking Transparency choice on iOS.

You can delete your account in Settings. Deleting the app removes local data on that device.

results.description:
Log every set — and film it. Levr is a full workout logger built for calisthenics.

Calisthenics is different. Your hardest work isn't a number in a table — it's a handstand you hold, a planche you fight for, a muscle-up you finally get clean. Holds need timing, and skills need video, because you get better by watching your form, not by feeling it. Levr does both: it logs every set like a serious strength app, and it films and times your holds automatically.

Prop your phone up, train, and it's all there — the numbers and the footage, side by side.

AUTOMATICALLY TIMED — EVERY VARIATION
Planches, front levers, handstands — Levr detects each hold and times it for you, no stopwatch, no scrubbing back. It reads the variation too, so you see the time you spent in a tuck planche versus a straddle, a tuck front lever versus a full, or a one-arm handstand versus two. Every variation, timed automatically.

SHAREABLE OVERLAYS
Turn any hold into a clip worth posting. Levr bakes a live overlay right into your video — a running hold timer, your center of mass, or a skeleton tracing your line — so your planche, front lever and handstand variations are ready to share.

FILM EVERY SET, SEE YOUR FORM
Every set is saved next to its own video, so your whole training history is on video. For skills like the handstand, Levr measures the angles at your joints and scores the hold — so you can see exactly what to fix. More movements are on the way.

FIND ANY SET IN SECONDS
Filter your whole video library by exercise, personal records, favorites, or length. Pull up every planche you've ever filmed — or just your best — in a couple of taps.

LOG EVERY WORKOUT
Weight, reps, duration, or distance — log any kind of training. Build routines or log freestyle. It's a complete logger; calisthenics is just where it feels at home.

SHARE WITH YOUR COACH
Upload your clips and your full training log to your own Google Drive. Your coach gets every set in a spreadsheet — with links straight to the video of the set — so they can watch your week and adjust your plan from anywhere.

IMPORT ANY PROGRAM USING AI
Levr's AI imports your routines from almost any source — images, documents, text, or a Google Sheet. No need to build them by hand.

BRING YOUR HISTORY
Coming from another app? Import your existing logs so day one isn't a blank slate.

YOUR VIDEO STAYS YOURS
Your training video stays on your device by default. Analytics are anonymous, and there are no ads.

Levr is a personal training tool — not a medical device, and not a replacement for good coaching. Train within your ability.

Tiqan is a calisthenics training app built around honest progression. Pick a goal — build strength, master a skill, or move better — and the program adapts to your level, equipment and recovery. Nothing is inflated, and nothing is guessed.


THREE GOALS, THREE REAL PROGRAMS

Tell Tiqan what you are training for and it builds the plan for it.

- Build Strength: a six-level ladder from Foundation to Elite, on 3-day Full Body, 4-day Upper/Lower or 6-day Push, Pull, Legs
- Master a Skill: step-by-step ladders to the handstand, front lever, planche and muscle-up
- Move Better: mobility, flexibility and functional movement, tracked by coverage not load
- Run one goal at a time, or keep all three going at once


PROGRAMS THAT GROW WITH YOU

After every session the engine decides whether to advance, hold or regress each movement. You do not tell it you got stronger; it works that out.

- Equipment-aware: pull-up bar, parallel bars, rings, or none of them — it programs only what you can actually do
- Intra-workout calibration: your first set tunes the sets that follow
- Plateau detection flags movements that have stalled
- Change your training days or equipment whenever life does — for good, or just while you travel


IT ADAPTS INSIDE THE SESSION TOO

New in 2.0. Most apps only adjust between workouts.

- Reps falling away mid-exercise? It offers to stop there and counts what you did, rather than watching you grind out junk sets
- Well under your recent numbers from the first set? It offers to finish the day lighter
- Both are offers with a decline, once per exercise. It notices; it does not nag


HONEST INSIGHTS

Most apps inflate numbers. Tiqan shows you the truth.

- Recovery reads your sleep, HRV against your own baseline, resting heart rate and active energy from Apple Health — and says which of those it is using today. No watch data last night? It says so instead of inventing a score
- Personal baselines: every metric reads "8 percent below your 6-week average", not a number floating in space
- Personal correlations: your strongest training day, what rest actually does for you
- Training Load with a 6-week reference line
- Personal Records timestamped, so you know if your best is fresh or stale


THE WORKOUT EXPERIENCE

- Tempo guidance per exercise: eccentric, pause, concentric, pause
- Form, tempo and effort logged per set — one tap each, and every one of them optional
- Auto-starting rest timer with one-tap skip
- Simple Mode skips the feedback prompts for a fast session
- Live Activities on the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen


APPLE WATCH, FIRST CLASS

A real Apple Watch app, not a remote control.

- Run the whole workout on the watch with no phone needed
- Open the iPhone mid-session to see a live mirror of it: exercise, set, target and heart rate
- Calories and heart rate sync to Apple Health automatically


BUILD YOUR OWN

- Custom programs with drag-and-drop scheduling
- Quick Workouts for one-off sessions
- 200+ calisthenics exercises with progression chains, form cues, common mistakes and animated demonstrations


ACROSS YOUR DEVICES

- iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, and on Mac through Designed for iPad
- iCloud sync keeps every device in step
- Home and Lock Screen widgets
- Light and Dark mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion
- Privacy first: your training data stays between you and Apple. No third-party tracking


FREE AND PRO

The adaptive engine is free. Answer a few questions, get a real program, and let it progress you — no trial, no card.

Pro adds the depth: all three goals at once, every skill ladder, the top of the strength ladder, the full insight charts, unlimited custom programs and workouts, and full workouts on Apple Watch. Both plans start with 7 days free.


Answer a few questions and start today. Every set you log shapes the next session.

results.description:
Daily Reps is an 8-week program by Strength Side built around 20-25 minute daily workouts combining bodyweight strength, mobility and conditioning.

Each day focuses on only 3 to 4 high bang for your buck exercises. Instead of loads of exercises for specific muscles, you put your energy and focus into a few main movements and get better and better at the basics.

Small doses, done frequently, are amazing for the body. You train consistently, stay fresh and keep your energy levels high.

The goal is simple. Build an incredibly fit, flexible and capable physique, without adding another exhausting workout to your life.

HOW DAILY REPS WORKS

We train every day. No days off. But that’s because the sessions are short.

Every day, open the app to see 3 to 4 exercises. Each exercise has a rep goal and different levels to choose from.

We don’t prescribe any sets. Chip away at the rep goal in one session or throughout your day.

Do a set, log your reps and see how many you have remaining.

The app saves your previous workout numbers so you can do the same or try to beat them. As you get in better shape, challenge yourself with harder variations.

WHAT YOU GET

• 8 weeks of daily workouts blending strength, mobility and conditioning
• A week nine retest, so your progress is something you can actually see
• Video demos for every exercise so you know exactly how it should look
• Multiple levels for each movement, so you can scale any exercise up or down
• Logging that tracks your reps, your sessions and your progress
• Streaks and history so you can watch the days add up

TRAIN AT HOME

Most of Daily Reps is bodyweight. You’ll use a pull-up bar, gymnastic rings, a jump rope and resistance bands. No gym required.

WHO IT'S FOR

If life has gotten busier and training hard is leaving you more beat up than built up, this was made for you.

Busy parents. Working professionals. People in their 30s, 40s and beyond who want to stay strong, move well and still have energy left for everything else.

A little of the right exercise done every single day will take you way further than a lot done sporadically.

This is our simplest but maybe most profound program. Let's get to training.

Daily Reps is a general fitness and wellness app. It is not medical advice and is not a substitute for care from a qualified professional. Consult a professional before starting any exercise program. Results vary.

The plank (also called a front hold, hover, or abdominal bridge) is an isometric core strength exercise that involves maintaining a difficult position for extended periods of time. 
The most common plank is the front plank which is held in a push-up position with the body's weight borne on forearms, elbows, and toes. 
Many variations exist such as the side plank and the reverse plank.The plank is commonly practiced in pilates and yoga, and by those training forboxing and other sports. 
The plank strengthens the abdominals, back, and shoulders.
